tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Inspect the current document, revision, capabilities and engine.

tools.name: document_read
tools.description: Read every page/frame and the selected frame text; offsets belong to the selected frame.

tools.name: document_edit
tools.description: Replace a UTF-16 range on grapheme boundaries. Revision and idempotency key are required.

tools.name: document_format
tools.description: Format a UTF-16 range, retaining explicit font/language and custom spacing.

tools.name: document_save
tools.description: Atomically save a lab document; detects external changes and protects source files.

tools.name: document_open
tools.description: Open or migrate a document; fontPaths resolves exact hashes at new paths.

tools.name: page_configure
tools.description: Set dimensions and margins for one page. Full content frames follow its content area.

tools.name: history_undo
tools.description: Undo a document, page, frame, text or formatting transaction.

tools.name: history_redo
tools.description: Redo an undone document transaction.

tools.name: fonts_list
tools.description: Inspect loaded font identities and the registered layer recipe.

tools.name: fonts_load
tools.description: Privately load a local static TTF without a system font install.

tools.name: layout_inspect
tools.description: Inspect the page and all its frame glyphs, including overflow.

tools.name: layout_hit_test
tools.description: Map page coordinates to frame identity and native UTF-16 caret.

tools.name: render_png
tools.description: Render the shared glyph layout to PNG, optionally a bounded tile for a huge page.

tools.name: view_configure
tools.description: Control layer visibility, flat layer colors, preview mode, zoom and overlays. monochromePaper selects black or white paper for monochrome preview and proofs; auto follows the document background.

tools.name: features_configure
tools.description: Toggle kerning and standard ligatures; reuses the same text source.

tools.name: selection_set
tools.description: Select a grapheme-aligned UTF-16 range, optionally in another frame.

tools.name: ui_inspect
tools.description: Read native accessibility, selection and UI state.

tools.name: ui_capture
tools.description: Save a PNG of the lab widget for local troubleshooting.

tools.name: diagnostics_tail
tools.description: Read recent correlated diagnostics.

tools.name: document_new
tools.description: Create a new document; explicit discard is required for unsaved text.

tools.name: document_title
tools.description: Rename the document.

tools.name: document_preflight
tools.description: Validate a file and list exact missing font identities without changing the document.

tools.name: document_save_as
tools.description: Save at a new path, retaining the previous document and its recovery history.

tools.name: document_recent
tools.description: List recent local document paths.

tools.name: document_find
tools.description: Find literal text on grapheme boundaries across all frames.

tools.name: document_replace
tools.description: Replace all literal matches as one undoable transaction.

tools.name: paragraph_format
tools.description: Set line height, paragraph spacing, alignment and left tab stops.

tools.name: page_add
tools.description: Add an independent page with a full content frame.

tools.name: page_delete
tools.description: Remove a page and its frames; undo restores all content.

tools.name: frame_add
tools.description: Add an independent text frame to the selected page; coordinates use points.

tools.name: frame_select
tools.description: Select the editing frame and invalidate commands prepared for a previous frame.

tools.name: frame_configure
tools.description: Set frame position, dimensions, label and visible/clipped overflow.

tools.name: frame_delete
tools.description: Remove a text frame; undo restores its full semantic text.

tools.name: styles_list
tools.description: List named character styles.

tools.name: styles_define
tools.description: Create or replace a named character style.

tools.name: styles_apply
tools.description: Apply a named character style to the selected frame range.

tools.name: recipe_configure
tools.description: Validate and select three compatible fonts for registered flat color.

tools.name: palette_apply
tools.description: Apply an explicit three-color palette to the current recipe.

tools.name: clipboard_read
tools.description: Return plain source text and semantic clipboard data for a selection.

tools.name: clipboard_paste
tools.description: Paste validated semantic clipboard data without discarding run metadata.

tools.name: recovery_list
tools.description: List recoverable checkpoints from sessions that are no longer running.

tools.name: recovery_restore
tools.description: Recover an interrupted session without overwriting its source document.

tools.name: history_list
tools.description: List revision summaries, undo capacity and the last durable revision.

tools.name: render_svg
tools.description: Export a portable outline SVG proof; bitmap-only glyphs fail explicitly.

tools.name: typesetting_read
tools.description: Read persisted frame policy, flow chains and versioned line-break profiles.

tools.name: typesetting_configure
tools.description: Enable derived layout, leading distribution and baseline grid for the source frame.

tools.name: paragraph_rules
tools.description: Apply keep-with-next, keep-together and widow/orphan minima to selected paragraphs.

tools.name: flow_set
tools.description: Flow one source story through empty equal-width frames; never duplicate or delete source text.

tools.name: breaks_profile
tools.description: Create a new revision of explicit language line-break tailoring; no automatic hyphenation dictionary.

tools.name: breaks_inspect
tools.description: Inspect native and tailored Unicode break opportunities with source offsets.

tools.name: breaks_insert
tools.description: Explicitly insert a soft hyphen or line separator at a grapheme boundary.

tools.name: collision_configure
tools.description: Set allow/warn/repair, minimum clearance, expansion/iteration budget and reserved bounds.

tools.name: collision_inspect
tools.description: Report before/after collisions, protected joins, solver decisions and unresolved constraints.

tools.name: optical_set
tools.description: Replace explicit pair spacing rules, stored separately from font kerning. Legacy independence must be declared.

tools.name: pairs_inspect
tools.description: Measure an isolated pair with/without font kerning and explicit optical spacing; live source is unchanged.

tools.name: specimen_create
tools.description: Create an editable dense specimen on a new page from explicit source symbols.

tools.name: ui_workspace
tools.description: Show or hide source/diagnostics, select a control panel, toggle guides and fit the page for visual review.

tools.name: paint_read
tools.description: Read versioned lighting, source bindings, page background and raster settings.

tools.name: paint_configure
tools.description: Change the outline-derived paint recipe and advance its revision; source text is unchanged.

tools.name: paint_bind
tools.description: Bind an exact font identity to verified layer fonts or derived treatment; roman-translation-1 selects the independent archived Roman bevel/glow profile.

tools.name: publication_configure
tools.description: Configure page background (#AARRGGBB) and default raster DPI.

tools.name: publication_preflight
tools.description: Inspect all pages, font identities, overset, effect clipping and extraction limitations.

tools.name: publication_export
tools.description: Export PNG, SVG or multipage PDF; decorative SVG/PDF requires explicit raster policy and DPI.

tools.name: font_build
tools.description: Build the explicitly reduced flat COLR v0/CPAL font plus reproducible provenance manifest; retain mono outlines.

tools.name: glyph_proof
tools.description: Render a glyph composite or an individual source layer on a shared canvas; report exact layer registration.

tools.name: language_read
tools.description: Read a language revision, collection or record with immutable identities and provenance.

tools.name: language_revisions
tools.description: List language revisions pinned in this document, including hashes and collection counts.

tools.name: language_diff
tools.description: Inspect added, removed and changed records before adopting another revision. Page text never changes.

tools.name: language_adopt
tools.description: Pin a previously retained language revision; existing corpus links retain their original revision.

tools.name: language_record_put
tools.description: Create or replace one typed record as a new immutable language revision. Stable IDs survive edits.

tools.name: language_record_delete
tools.description: Remove a record in a new revision; referenced records cannot be removed. Undo restores the prior pin.

tools.name: language_archive_import
tools.description: Verify and import both local translation charts, language terms, glosses, tense conflict, orthography and Unta data into a new revision.

tools.name: language_import
tools.description: Import a hash-checked portable language package as a new revision; retain the previous revision.

tools.name: language_export
tools.description: Export the selected revision as portable, hash-checked JSON with original citations. Does not include document text or fonts.

tools.name: language_publish
tools.description: Publish a searchable, printable dictionary, grammar book or interlinear corpus from the pinned data.

tools.name: lexicon_search
tools.description: Search headwords, senses, labels and variants literally; no normalization of historical spellings.

tools.name: orthography_transliterate
tools.description: Apply an explicit transliteration profile. Forward trace preserves unknown slots and ambiguous reverse readings.

tools.name: orthography_input
tools.description: Insert a registered symbol key through the guarded native text writer; requires an exact compatible selected font.

tools.name: corpus_search
tools.description: Literal concordances and surface frequencies in the pinned corpus. Entry search uses explicit token links.

tools.name: corpus_links
tools.description: Inspect bilingual document links, including stale text ranges and links pinned to older language revisions.

tools.name: corpus_link
tools.description: Link a cited corpus pair to explicit source/translation UTF-16 document ranges. Adaptations must be documented.

tools.name: corpus_unlink
tools.description: Remove a document corpus link; undo restores it.

tools.name: numbers_format
tools.description: Format exact integer-string numerator/denominator values in a versioned base-12 convention; report repeats or truncation.

tools.name: numbers_parse
tools.description: Parse finite or repeating base-12 notation to an exact reduced rational, without floating point.

tools.name: ui_sidebar
tools.description: Expand, collapse, pin or resize the left controls. Saved workspace preferences; no document, zoom or undo change. Collapsing unpins; pinning expands.

tools.name: ui_sidebar_inspect
tools.description: Read left-panel visibility, pin, remembered width, selected tab and preference errors.

tools.name: view_tool
tools.description: Choose Select to click a frame to edit, or Hand to drag the view. No document revision or undo entry.

tools.name: view_pan
tools.description: Move the page by viewport logical pixels, without changing text, selection or document history.

tools.name: view_center
tools.description: Bring the current page back to the center of the viewport.

tools.name: view_inspect
tools.description: Read the active navigation tool, page origin, viewport and zoom.

tools.name: performance_inspect
tools.description: Read bounded shaping/cache counters and reliability limits.

tools.name: backup_create
tools.description: Back up the last saved file and exact font bytes into a verified portable bundle. Does not save unsaved edits.

tools.name: backup_verify
tools.description: Verify every bundle member and all source font identities without opening the document.

tools.name: backup_restore
tools.description: Recover to a NEW directory, retaining the exact original and relocating verified font paths. Does not replace the open editor.

tools.name: jobs_export
tools.description: Start an isolated cancellable PNG/SVG/PDF proof from the current immutable revision; inspect jobs.status for completion or errors.

tools.name: jobs_status
tools.description: Inspect proof job state, phase, revision, staleness, output and full worker log path.

tools.name: jobs_cancel
tools.description: Cancel this editor’s proof worker before publication. Never writes a partial destination.

tools.name: forge_create
tools.description: Create an independent local language project. Does not change the Workbench document.

tools.name: forge_open
tools.description: Open a Forge SQLite project. Existing drafts are already durable.

tools.name: forge_read
tools.description: Read an immutable version or the active autosaved draft, including dictionary, wiki and tests.

tools.name: forge_status
tools.description: Read project identity, generation, active branch, head and draft status.

tools.name: forge_history
tools.description: List immutable language versions with parent hashes.

tools.name: forge_diff
tools.description: Compare stable records, wiki pages and tests between two versions.

tools.name: forge_draft_replace
tools.description: Validate and atomically autosave an entire proposed snapshot. Commit separately to name its version.

tools.name: forge_record_put
tools.description: Autosave a wiki page, test or typed language record with stable identity and a project generation guard.

tools.name: forge_commit
tools.description: Atomically freeze the entire dictionary, wiki, grammar, decisions and test suite as a named version.

tools.name: forge_branch
tools.description: Create and select a branch from an immutable version. Retains the old branch draft.

tools.name: forge_checkout
tools.description: Select a branch without discarding either branch draft.

tools.name: forge_export
tools.description: Export all committed versions, branch drafts and run records as a hashed portable bundle.

tools.name: forge_restore
tools.description: Restore a verified Forge bundle to a NEW project path.

tools.name: forge_test_run
tools.description: Run language assertions and render a frozen bilingual test with the approved presentation. Meaning still requires review.

tools.name: forge_runs
tools.description: Inspect test outcomes, pinned versions, diagnostics and output paths.

tools.name: forge_run_open
tools.description: Open a generated test in a separate Workbench process, preserving this document. Logs stdout/stderr.

tools.name: ui_forge
tools.description: Show Workbench or Forge and select its workspace section/version or stable wiki/entry/test ID without modifying the document.

tools.name: forge_lab_read
tools.description: Read the versioned rule and test definitions; omit version for the durable draft.

tools.name: forge_lab_put
tools.description: Validate and autosave a declarative rule or test case; commit separately to freeze it.

tools.name: forge_lab_remove
tools.description: Remove a draft case or unreferenced rule. Frozen versions retain the original.

tools.name: forge_lab_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate finite forms, scalar inventory and explicitly annotated clauses. Draft previews are not frozen runs.

tools.name: forge_lab_run
tools.description: Run the frozen language suite and retain coverage, expected/actual results and content hashes in a new directory.

tools.name: forge_lab_compare
tools.description: Run exactly the same pinned cases against two frozen language versions. Defaults to the before version suite.

tools.name: forge_merge_preview
tools.description: Plan a three-way merge from a branch frozen head into the active clean branch. Inspect base, parents and every conflict.

tools.name: forge_merge_apply
tools.description: Atomically commit a reviewed merge with both parents. Require the exact preview, generation and every conflict resolution.

tools.name: forge_releases
tools.description: List immutable named language releases and pinned versions; releases never follow a moving branch.

tools.name: forge_release_read
tools.description: Read a named language release, embedded test evidence and outstanding review status.

tools.name: forge_release_create
tools.description: Freeze a named release with matching suite and bound-page evidence. Experimental releases retain review gaps; stable gates require full passes and an accepting reviewer.

tools.name: forge_release_export
tools.description: Export a language release with its dictionary, wiki, assertions and embedded reports. Proof/font binaries remain separately hash-referenced.
